mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 64 degrees with overcast skies by the Verona Public Library and we are seeing a waning crescent moon tonight.

City officials have announced that phase two of the Aldi development and road construction begins the week of September 7, which will shift traffic patterns on highway M. Additionally, the Verona Police Department has arrested a teacher for an inappropriate relationship with a student that took place in 2019.

You have plenty to choose from, starting with yoga sessions today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus or Wisconsin Brewing Company, and throughout the week, look forward to the downtown farmer's market and more live music at Paddy Mac's and Bailey's Run.
The Verona Police Department has reported that on Sunday, August 30, 2026, they were informed of an incident involving a school staff member, which has since led to an arrest.
Today's flavor of the day is Georgia Peach and the restaurant will open today at 10:00 AM.
